scope: Independent source review and six offline Python source guards only; no Rust build, operator execution, model, or benchmark by reviewer.
checks: Original kernels preserved byte-for-byte as prefix; explicit new enum retains independent Compact and Expanded paths and Expanded default.
Prefill still borrows original expanded work.k and calls unchanged compact attention; complete-prefix and one-token append/decode limits remain explicit.
Prefix split dot retains four chronological FMA accumulators, operand order and reduction tree; generated K and fixed AXPY64 helpers remain unchanged.
Safe adapter validates 16/8/64 shape, single query, exact slices, image/query interval and AVX2/FMA availability before unsafe dispatch.
Storage validates duplicate bits and capacity before mutation; exact reused storage/model-test bytes are independently pinned.

Capture binds original archive, exactly four changed/two added runtime members, copied sources and qualification harness; fresh isolated target and Cargo manifest/src/artifact checks precede executable preservation.
Operator inventory requires all thirteen disjoint selected tests, actual successful status lines and exit codes, with source/binary closure after execution.
Execution-only run_model helper is intentionally excluded and must bind its own source closure at launch.
limitations: Source/offline guards do not establish compiled arithmetic or full-model parity.
No performance/default-promotion claim; later built operator, model and timing evidence remains separate.
